High point near Gwangju → Photo stop in Hwaseong-si is the reward section in Seoul. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

Treat Photo stop in Hwaseong-si → Food stop near Seonwon as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Food stop near Seonwon → Near Anyang-si is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.
